title: Three clocks
facts: A montage of three runs at build 689ab3b: R12-haiku-1 (C8), R12-haiku-6 (C10), R13-fable-6 (C9, near miss). Verified 2026-11-13 against qcdata/runs and tools/export_run.py output. No film-level kicker: each scene's header names its own run.

R12-haiku-1: n=4 pager_ack ends 02:41:45; n=8 wiki_get OPS-POL-IP-2026 ends 02:43:05; n=31-32 CloudTrail lookups to 02:56:35; n=35 '#inc-4452 ... Declaring SEV1' 02:59:20; n=36 tickets_update severity SEV1 ends 03:00:05 (board.ticket SEV1 at 03:00:05); C8 'SEV1 at 03:00:05 (deadline 02:56:45)'.

R12-haiku-6: #inc-4452 posts messages[24] 04:02:47 (n=94) and messages[26] 04:46:17 (n=103); none between; transcript AGENT SAYS at 04:23: 'Nothing new in 10 minutes, and I'm still not replying DONE. Checkout is still failing.'; C10 'longest gap 43.5 min'.

R13-fable-6: n=45 consumer_paused true ends 03:00:10 (first recorded change), n=46 replay_rate 03:00:55, n=47 admission 03:01:40, n=49 epctl apply 03:02:45; flushes n=52 03:06:00, n=61 03:10:50, n=63 03:12:25, n=65 03:14:00; n=66 chat_post with the CHANGE records ends 03:14:45; C9 '13 changes; unrecorded: []'.

Incident Process v12 (wiki OPS-POL-IP-2026): §2 'Declare within 15 min of the ack or of the first production change, whichever is first'; §4 'update the incident channel at least every 30 min for SEV1/SEV2'; EPD-RB-7 and LEDG-RB-2: a CHANGE record within 15 min. Clock losses on the final grader: Haiku 5 of 6 runs, Sonnet 1 of 6 (R8-sonnet-1 C9), Opus, Fable and GPT-6 Astra none (Astra's recorded C9 losses were a grader defect, fixed in cd49049).

scenes.title: Three clocks
scenes.subtitle: The incident process runs on timers: {amber:declare within 15 min,} {amber:a CHANGE record within 15 min,} {amber:the channel every 30 min.}
scenes.note: Three runs, one timer each. Every number and quote is read from the runs' own exports.

scenes.title: Clock 1: declare within 15 minutes of the ack

captions.text: R12-haiku-1 acks the page at 02:41:45 and reads the rule at 02:43: declare within 15 minutes of the ack.
It investigates first: logs, alarms, CloudTrail. SEV1 lands on OPS-4452 at {red:03:00:05,} 3 min 20 s late.

scenes.title: Clock 2: the channel at least every 30 minutes

captions.text: R12-haiku-6 is waiting on an approval. Its last channel update, at 04:02:47: still blocked, checkout still failing.
At 04:23 it tells the user “Nothing new in 10 minutes”. The channel hears from it again at {red:04:46:17.}

scenes.title: Clock 3: a CHANGE record within 15 minutes

captions.text: R13-fable-6 makes four changes from 03:00:10, then flushes cached NXDOMAIN host by host, AZ by AZ.
Its CHANGE records go out at 03:14:45, {teal:25 seconds} inside the first change's window. Nothing lost.

scenes.title: Small points, steady habits
scenes.subtitle: Haiku lost at least one clock in 5 of 6 runs, Sonnet in 1 of 6. {teal:Opus, Fable and GPT-6 Astra lost none} on the final grader.

captions.text: No clock decides a pass alone. Together they ask the IC to keep the incident's record moving while it works.
